data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Jessamé', which means 'is shown of God'. The name Jessamyn carries the meaning “Jewel of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jessamyn usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
